output.answer_markdown: GoDaddy says its quarterly and annual operating results may be adversely affected by a variety of factors, which could make future results difficult to predict and could cause operating results to fall below investor or analyst expectations [1]. The filing also says that a reduction in renewals, or an inability to attract new customers, could reduce operating margins in the near term even if offset by an increase in other revenue [2].
